selection_reasoning: The task 'find red_stained_glass' is a single atomic task that is straightforward, observable, and verifiable. The agent must navigate the environment to locate a red stained glass block. This task does not require deep Minecraft domain knowledge — the agent simply needs to visually identify and approach a distinctively colored block. It is easily verifiable by checking the agent's proximity to or view of the block. As a single-task selection (k=1), no multi-hop dependency chain is needed, but the task itself can involve navigation and visual identification sub-skills.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the stone brick building and look at the red stained glass cross pattern. The target center is at spawn-relative [8, 3, 8] (confirmed via sandbox: 5 red_stained_glass blocks placed at ~7-9,~2-4,~8 forming a cross). max_distance=5 allows natural viewing distance from in front of the building. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the glass, not just standing nearby.

scene_description: A small grass clearing with several structures. The main feature is a stone brick building (~8 blocks from spawn at ~6-10, ~1-4, ~8-10) with a prominent red stained glass cross pattern on its front face. Additional structures include an oak plank hut to the left (~-4 to -2, ~1-3, ~6-8), a cobblestone block to the right (~3-5, ~1-2, ~-3 to -1), a lantern at ~0,~1,~4, and a villager near ~-1,~1,~3. The red stained glass is clearly visible from spawn and forms a distinctive cross pattern that the player must navigate toward and identify.
task_text: Find the red stained glass blocks. Navigate toward the stone brick building with the red glass cross pattern and approach it.
design_notes: The red stained glass forms a cross/plus pattern on the front (south-facing) wall of the stone brick building at relative coords ~6-10, ~1-4, ~8-10. Five red_stained_glass blocks are placed: three horizontal at y=3 (x=7,8,9) and two vertical at x=8 (y=2,4). The building is ~8 blocks from spawn, clearly visible from the start position. Additional structures (oak hut, cobblestone block, lantern, villager) add visual variety without obstructing the path. The grass platform is 21x21 blocks ensuring plenty of room.
